Thank you for the update and the shipping label.

The unit has been safely packed in the original box and shipped via UPS today. As requested, I have written Shop···· clearly on the outside of the box.

I have attached photos of the package and the drop-off receipt for your reference (note that the receipt is in Norwegian, but it shows the tracking and drop-off confirmation).

Looking forward to receiving the tracking details for the Hammer Miner Thor P2 once the package arrives at your warehouse!

Hi Raymond,

Thank you, that is exactly what we needed. The photos and the drop-off receipt are on your RMA, and UPS (number hidden) is now showing as on its way to Waddinxveen. The N. receipt is no problem.

Your replacement is already set up and reserved on our side. It is a Hammer Miner Thor P2 (10 TH/s), matched to your plug, on its own order at no charge, and it is held only until your NerdQaxe++ is checked in at the warehouse. Nothing else is waiting on you and nobody needs to re-approve it.

Thanks for packing it up so quickly.
